_comment: DEMO CONTENT. Fictional bank, fictional policies. Answers are read almost verbatim on a call, so they are written to be spoken: contractions, no markdown, no symbols, numbers in words where a symbol would be read out wrong.

faqs.a: The branch counters are open ten to four, Monday to Friday. Video KYC runs longer, nine to six on weekdays and nine to two on Saturday. Our fraud desk never closes.

faqs.q: What is KYC and why do I have to do it again?
faqs.a: It's the bank re-checking your ID and address every few years. It's a rule we have to follow, not something you've done wrong. It takes about ten minutes.

faqs.q: What happens if I don't update my KYC?
faqs.a: The account can get restricted, which means you'd have trouble using it until the update is done. That's why we'd rather get you booked in now.

faqs.q: Can I do my KYC right now on this call?
faqs.a: Not on this call, I'm afraid. It has to be done with an officer, either over video or at the branch, and I can book you the next slot either way.

faqs.q: Do I have to come to the branch?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. Most people do it over a video call from home, which takes about ten minutes. If you'd rather come in, the branch works too.
One photo ID and one proof of your current address. An Aadhaar or passport works for the ID, and a recent bill or bank statement works for the address.

faqs.q: Is there any charge for this?
faqs.a: No, updating your KYC is free, and so is reactivating a dormant account.

faqs.q: My account has been frozen or gone dormant. Can you fix it?
faqs.a: Yes, that's usually a KYC update plus a quick reactivation at the counter. I can book both into one appointment.

faqs.q: I think I have money in an old account I forgot about.
faqs.a: That happens more than you'd think. Bring whatever you still have, an old passbook, a cheque book, anything with the account on it, and an officer will trace it for you.

faqs.q: Can I claim money from an account in my late father's name?
faqs.a: Yes, as a nominee or a legal heir. It needs a separate appointment because the officer has to see the original documents, and I'm very sorry for your loss.

faqs.q: How long does it take to reflect on my account?
faqs.a: Usually within two working days of the documents being verified, and you'll get a message when it's done.

faqs.q: Can I cancel or change my appointment?
faqs.a: Of course. Let us know a couple of hours ahead if you can, so someone else can take the slot. There's no charge either way.
You can, during counter hours. You might wait a while at a busy time, so an appointment is quicker if you can plan it.
We're at Hollowfield House in G Block, Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai. It's a short walk from the main road and there's parking behind the building.

faqs.q: Someone called asking for my OTP. Was that you?
faqs.a: No, and please don't share it with anyone. Nobody from this bank will ever ask you for an OTP, a PIN or a card number. If you've already shared it, call our fraud desk straight away.
Call our fraud desk right away on one eight hundred, two six six, double zero zero one. They're open all day and night and they'll block it in a minute.

faqs.q: Can you tell me my balance?
faqs.a: Not from here, I'm afraid. Balances only come from net banking, the app, an ATM or an officer who can verify who you are.

faqs.q: Can I open a new account?
faqs.a: Yes, savings or current. It's a branch appointment and takes about twenty minutes. Shall I find you a time?
